title: Geoffrey Hinton talk "What is wrong with convolutional neural nets ?"
summary: Geoffrey Hinton gives an MIT talk on what is wrong with convolutional neural networks and introduces his capsules project. The description points to the capsule network papers.
why: Recommended as Hinton's own explanation of capsule networks and his critique of pooling in CNNs.

quote.text: Hinton explains the concept of capsules in this video
